summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-U7 admits no external crate. academic-transcript reuses sha2 and thiserror from earlier reviewed receipts and links academic-admission, academic-domain, academic-vault, and (as a dev edge only) academic-crypto by path; it adds only one workspace path package. No PDF, OCR, image, or XML dependency was added: the PDF corpus is written by a deterministic builder inside the crate and read by a declared-layout parser.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-transcript is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns the canonical transcript record, the three declared import parses, the import-versus-confirmed claim split, field-level checksum reconciliation, the redaction projection, and the admission gate every profile-touching import passes. Keeping them together is what lets the redaction projection be the only route to an export and the reconciled transcript be the only route to a confirmation; splitting them across the domain, vault, and store crates would put a transcript identity value on four boundaries instead of one.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, reads no environment variable outside the non-default phase2-fault-injection feature, spawns no process, and runs no build script. Its product host interaction is bounded file work below a caller-supplied profile root: the admission receipt read the verifier performs, and the import session's lease, staging, and confirmed-set files.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-transcript links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
